notes: Every credited second rests on a bridge anchor: level C, labeled via_bridge.

Unlike (a), (c) and (d), these records count toward logged_s and ai_logged_s: they come from heartbeats that passed the peer-process check (D19). logged_s = ai_logged_s = 3 + 117 + 3 + 117 + 3 = 243 s, because the editor heartbeats share their edits' millisecond.

level_c_cap_s = min(240, 243 / 3) = 81 s: the most a program that opts in to level C could take, and only inside a commit interval whose closing commit is forge-verified (DESIGN 5.2, D5). This case has no commit, so it is 0 submittable as recorded.
Uncapped, each 5,000-line edit would refill the bucket to its 600 s cap and turn the 40 s from :23 to the next lead, and everything after 14:07:23, into READ.
The SUP and READ split, agent_running_s and the X.no_anchor seconds after each edit depend on the erratum: no agent.stop says when a bridge turn ends.
